questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must train young dentists in end-of-career management. What is the first piece of advice he should give them?
options: End of career is a constraint
End of career is prepared from the beginning
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'End of career is prepared from the beginning. The more you anticipate, the more serene you are.' Sofia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must create a training center for seniors. What is the main objective?
options: Train senior dentists in transmission and retirement
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'The objective is to train senior dentists in transmission and retirement.' Ahmed: 'I will participate in this training.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must evaluate the performance of a young dentist in career management. Which measurement is the most important?
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'The quality of career planning is the most important measure.' Sofia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must handle a crisis: a senior colleague refuses to prepare his succession. What is the priority?
options: Listen to him and inform him of the risks
Force him to prepare his succession
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'The priority is to listen and inform about the risks.' Ahmed: 'I will help you manage this situation.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must train interns in professional risk management for seniors. What is the fundamental principle?
options: Professional risk management is a responsibility
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Professional risk management is a fundamental responsibility.' Sofia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must create a guide to good practices for seniors. What is the main reference?
options: Seniors' experience and good transmission practices
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Good practices should be based on seniors' experience and good transmission practices.' Ahmed: 'I will contribute to this guide.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must train young dentists in career optimization. What is the key message?
options: Career optimization is a long-term investment
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Career optimization is a long-term investment.' Sofia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must create a research program on seniors' careers. What is the main objective?
options: Improve the quality of life of seniors at the end of their careers
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Research aims to improve the quality of life of seniors at the end of their careers.' Ahmed: 'I will participate in the research.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must create a reference practice for seniors. What is the pillar of excellence?
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Excellence is based on the quality of transmission and mentoring.' Sofia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must evaluate the impact of seniors on the profession. What is the role of seniors?
options: They are the pillars of transmission and professional memory
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Seniors are the pillars of transmission and professional memory.' Ahmed: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must train interns in innovation for seniors. What current trend is important?
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Innovation concerns assistive technologies, telemedicine, and adapted continuing education.' Sofia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must create a competency evaluation system for seniors. What is the objective?
options: Improve quality of care and transmission
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Evaluation aims to improve quality of care and transmission.' Ahmed: 'I will participate in the evaluation.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must handle a conflict related to transmission. What is the right attitude?
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Dialogue and mediation are essential for resolving transmission conflicts.' Sofia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must write an article on the future of seniors in dentistry. Which trend should be emphasized?
options: The importance of transmission and professional memory
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'The future lies in the importance of transmission and professional memory.' Ahmed: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must create a quality label for senior practices. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Quality of transmission and mentoring are the fundamental criteria.' Sofia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must give a speech on the importance of seniors. What message should she convey?
options: Seniors are the memory and wisdom of the profession
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Seniors are the memory and wisdom of the profession.' Ahmed: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must create a scholarship for studies on professional aging. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Encouraging research on professional aging is an investment for the future.' Sofia: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must pass on her knowledge of career management. What is the most effective method?
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Personalized mentoring and case studies are the most effective methods.' Ahmed: 'I will invest in mentoring.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must create a peer network for senior dentists. What is the objective?
options: Promote mutual aid and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Mutual aid and sharing are essential for seniors.' Sofia: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must write a conclusion to her work on seniors. What is the final sentence?
options: Seniors are the soul of the profession
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Seniors are the soul of the profession.' Ahmed: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Skills passed on and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Skills passed on and an example to follow are the most beautiful legacy.' Sofia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must train future senior mentors. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission.' Ahmed: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed must write a letter to future dentists about professional aging. What message should he convey?
options: Aging is a natural stage that must be prepared for
questions.explanation: Ahmed explains: 'Aging is a natural stage that must be prepared for.' Sofia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must create an award for senior dentists. What is the purpose?
options: Stimulate excellence in transmission and mentoring
questions.explanation: Sofia explains: 'Stimulating excellence in transmission and mentoring is essential for the evolution of the profession.' Ahmed: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed, after a fulfilling career, receives a national tribute. Dr. Sofia is by his side. What is Ahmed's message to young dentists?
options: The career is an adventure that must be prepared and passed on
The career is of no interest
questions.explanation: Ahmed concludes: 'The career is an adventure that must be prepared and passed on. It gives meaning to our lives.' Sofia: 'I am proud of you.'
